page.layout: One printed page, text in one column with marginal section numbers at the right. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: medium adducto, duo praeclara Dei μεγα λέα[?], quae ordine sibi succedunt, uidelicet Mortificationem & Viuificationem, celebrat. Vtrumq; sane Deo tribuitur 1.Sam. 2.6. Iehouah occidit & uiuificat: descendere facit ad sepulcrum, & ascendere facit e sepulcro.
main_text.head: Quomodo autem suos mortificat Dominus?
main_text.p: 1.[?]Cum senfum praesentiae gratiae suae aliquandiu subducit, ut homo suae uanitatis & fragilitatis coarguatur. Id fit, cum eo res illius redeunt, ut cum Dauide pre-cetur[?]. Quousque Iehouah oblitus fceris mei penitus? Quousque abscondes faciem tuam a me? Quamdiu disponam consilia in anima mea? anxietatem in corde meo quotidie? Vsquequo exaltabitur inimicus meus supra me? Psal. 13.1.2.
main_text.head: Quomodo autem eosdem uiuificat?
main_text.p: 3.[?]Cum paterno uultu eos respiciens, mala uel mitigat, uel tollit, uel bonorum spiritualium communionem longe ea exuberare facit. Atq; haec & alia petens Dauid: Respice, ait, & exaudi me Iehouah Deus meus: illumina oculos meos, ne ob dormiam in morte. Psal. eode, v.3. Item: Beatus est qui prudenter iudicat de afflicto

page.notes: Printed page 193, running head "IN JONAE CAP. II." Catchword at foot right reads "&os:" with a preceding asterisk-like mark; the reading is doubtful. Margin section numbers at the right of the "Cum senfum" and "Cum paterno" lines are read as "1." and "3."; both are doubtful. The Greek in the first line ("μεγα λέα") is only partly legible; the word after "Dei" is uncertain. "praecetur" after "pre-" is doubtful. "mala" (line starting "Ia uel mitigat") is a split word, read from the broken syllables "ma-" and "ia", and is doubtful. The final sentence ends mid-word at the printed hyphen "affli-" and continues on the next page. Long s printed as s throughout; "Pfal." read as Psal.
